info.title: CDESK API v3
info.description: The v3 API surface is a curated, well-documented subset of the CDESK API exposed under /api/v3/. Each v3 endpoint wraps an existing v1 handler and accepts a `returnFields[]` query parameter that filters the response `data` field by a whitelist of top-level keys. List endpoints also accept an `sb` filter (a base64-encoded search-builder JSON object) — see the `sb` query parameter on any list endpoint for the full syntax and a worked example, and the per-module `*SbFilterFields` schemas (e.g. `RequestSbFilterFields`) for the field keys you can filter on.

servers.description: CDESK API base — v3 endpoints live under /api/v3/.

post.summary: OAuth 2.0 client credentials — exchange client_id + client_secret for a short-lived login JWT (no user password).
post.description: Machine-to-machine login step 1 (RECOMMENDED for AI / integration clients — no user password, only the user id and the connector secret). Prerequisite: the target user must have an active OAuth 2.0 connector in CDESK (Connectors module); its signing key is the `client_secret`. The returned `access_token` is an HS256 JWT valid 5 MINUTES whose ONLY consumer is `POST /auth/login` — send it there as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` with no body credentials to receive the long-lived `apitoken`; the JWT is NOT accepted directly on other endpoints. Clients with a JWT library may skip this endpoint and mint the JWT locally: HS256 signed with the connector signing key, claims `{iss: 'external-auth-cdesk', sub: <user id>, aud: '<CDESK host>', iat, exp}` — `aud` must equal the host name exactly, keep `exp` short (~5 min). All resulting calls run under the target user's identity and ACL rights.

client_id.description: CDESK user id the token will act as. The user must have an active OAuth 2.0 connector assigned.

client_secret.description: The signing key configured on the user's OAuth 2.0 connector.

access_token.description: HS256 login JWT — send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` to `POST /auth/login` (no body credentials) to receive the long-lived apitoken. Not accepted directly on other endpoints.

expires_in.description: Validity in seconds (300 = 5 minutes) — complete the `POST /auth/login` exchange within this window.

400.description: Missing `client_id`/`client_secret`, or no active OAuth 2.0 connector is configured for the user.

404.description: No user exists for the given `client_id`.

post.summary: Log in (credentials OR a Bearer OAuth 2.0 JWT) and receive an apitoken.
post.description: Exchanges credentials for an apitoken (short hex string) plus a JWT access token. The apitoken is what the v3 endpoints expect — paste it into the Scalar 'Authorize' panel as `apitoken <token>` (literal `apitoken ` prefix). MACHINE FLOW: instead of credentials, send `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` (the HS256 JWT from `POST /auth/jwttoken`, or a locally-minted equivalent) with an empty JSON body `{}` — `login`/`password` are then not required; the response is identical. The apitoken expiration is SLIDING: each authenticated call prolongs it by the user's `auto_logout` minutes; it expires only after that much inactivity.

login.description: User name (email or login). If it contains an `@`, the suffix is used to auto-detect an LDAP connector.

connector_id.description: Optional. Force login via a specific LDAP connector (overrides auto-detection).

accessType.description: Optional. 0 = web app, 1 = mobile app, 2 = desktop app.

token.description: apitoken (40-hex) — use as `apitoken <token>` in the `Authorization` header for v3 calls.

accessToken.description: JWT access token — alternative to apitoken, sent as `Bearer <jwt>` in the `Authorization` header.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: Unix timestamp when the JWT expires.

302.description: Two-factor auth required — follow up with `POST /api/auth/twofactorauth/totpverify` using the `tfa-uid` cookie.

errno.description: Error code (1 wrong login, 2 wrong password, 4 admin blocked, 5 customer disabled, 6 too many requests, 11 authorization failed, 12 authorization no acc, 16 wrong URL).

get.summary: List tasks (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: List tasks. Accepts the shared `sb` filter — see the `sb` query parameter for syntax. Filterable field keys for this list are documented in the `TaskSbFilterFields` schema.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each task record (the records nested at `data.data` in the response envelope). Unknown fields are ignored. Pagination/meta wrappers are always preserved.

parameters.name: fieldset
parameters.description: Preset field group: `base`, `extended` (base+extended), `all` (base+extended+custom), or `custom`. Defaults to `extended` when omitted. Response is always ordered base → extended → custom. Composes with `returnFields[]` (union).

post.description: Creates a new task. Delegates to the v1 handler `\Module\Task\Module::postIndex` — ACL, admin scoping, and validation are inherited. Unknown fields are silently ignored. **Server-computed fields** (`assign_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `num`, `close_date`) must NOT be sent. `assign_id` is derived from which `*_id` parent you send (precedence: `contract_id` > `project_contract_id` > `request_id` > `task_id` > `company_id` > none). Enum ids (`type_id`, `type_2nd_id`, `status`, `place_id`) are tenant-specific — fetch them via `GET /v3/task/enums`. Full reference: `materials/api-v3-task-create-update-fields.md`.

solver_id.description: Primary assignee — FK to `user.id`. Must be visible to the caller (admin-scope filtered).

valid_from.description: Start datetime. Any string `strtotime()` accepts works; ISO-8601 with timezone offset recommended (e.g. `2026-05-20T08:00:00+02:00`).

valid_to.description: End/due datetime. Must be ≥ `valid_from`. Same format as `valid_from`.

description.description: Long-text body (rich HTML allowed). Full-text indexed.

type_id.description: Top-level task type — FK to `enums.id` (TASK_TYPES). Fetch from `/v3/task/enums` → `enums.type[]`. Required only when tenant setting `config.type.status == 2`.

type_2nd_id.description: Second-level type — FK to `enums.id` (TASK_TYPES) whose `parent_id == type_id`. Fetch from `/v3/task/enums` → `enums.type2nd[]`.

status.description: Task status enum id (NOT the action_code). Fetch from `/v3/task/enums` → `enums.status[]`. Default: open. Setting a completed status auto-sets `close_date` server-side.

fullday.description: Default `false`. When true, FE treats `valid_from`/`valid_to` as date-only.

private.description: Default `false`. Personal task — visibility restricted to creator + solver.

company_id.description: Link to a customer/partner — FK to `cdesk_companies.id`. Mutually exclusive with other `*_id` parents.

request_id.description: Link to a request — FK to `cd_req.id_req`. Mutually exclusive with other `*_id` parents.

contract_id.description: Link to a contract — FK to `cd_real_contracts.id_rc`. Mutually exclusive with other `*_id` parents.

project_contract_id.description: Link to a project contract — FK to `project_contracts.id`. Mutually exclusive with other `*_id` parents.

task_id.description: Parent task — FK to `tasks.id`. Mutually exclusive with other `*_id` parents. Cycle/max-depth (8) check runs server-side.

percent_done_manual.description: Manual progress 0–100 (default `0`). Locked once status is completed. Requires `task/fields/percent-done` write.

scheduling_mode.description: Gantt scheduling: manual vs auto. When auto + task has subordinates, dates become read-only. Requires `task/fields/scheduling-mode` write.

other_solvers_id.description: Helper assignees — array of user ids. Full replace (send `[]` or `null` to clear).

selectedTags.description: Tag ids (or `{id, name}` objects). Requires `task/fields/tags` write/create.

offer_item_id.description: Link to an offer item. One-shot — cannot be reassigned once set.

notify.description: Notification override. Non-null forces notifications even when nothing else changed.

attachment.description: File upload payload — see `BaseModel::processAttachment` for shape.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. `valid_to < valid_from`, cycle detected, max depth exceeded).

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in the `data` payload.

parameters.name: fieldset
parameters.description: Preset field group: `base`, `extended` (base+extended), `all` (base+extended+custom), or `custom`. Defaults to `extended` when omitted. Response is always ordered base → extended → custom. Composes with `returnFields[]` (union).

put.summary: Update a task (partial update; same handler as POST).
put.description: Partial update — send only the fields you want to change. Underlying CDESK convention is POST-as-update, so PUT delegates to the same `postIndex` handler as `POST /v3/task`. **Optimistic locking**: the body must include `timestamp_check` equal to the `timestamp_check` value returned by GET (every fieldset includes it; for tasks it carries the record's `updated_at`), or the server returns a `recordUpdated` error. A task that has never been modified has a null `updated_at` — the check is skipped then, so omit the field rather than sending null. All other field semantics, ACL gates, and enum sources match `POST /v3/task` — see that endpoint's description and `materials/api-v3-task-create-update-fields.md`.

schema.description: All fields below are optional on update. Send only what you want to change.

timestamp_check.description: REQUIRED for optimistic locking (skipped only for never-modified tasks). Must equal the `timestamp_check` (the record's `updated_at`) you received when last fetching this task.

solver_id.description: Primary assignee. Cannot be changed once the task is in a completed status.

status.description: Setting a completed status auto-sets `close_date` and locks `percent_done_manual`.

company_id.description: Reparenting — sending a different `*_id` may be rejected if the FE-level `disableAssign` rules apply to your role.

task_id.description: Parent task. Cycle/max-depth check runs server-side.

other_solvers_id.description: Full replace. Send `[]` or `null` to clear.

offer_item_id.description: One-shot; cannot be reassigned once set.

subordinate_task_id.description: Update-only validation hint — used by the Gantt module to cycle-check when reparenting a subtree under this task. Not stored.

durationGap.description: Days by which to shift dependent subordinates when moving dates under auto-scheduling. Not stored.

400.description: Validation error (cycle, date order, max depth, etc.).

404.description: Task not found in caller's admin scope.

409.description: Optimistic-lock failure — task was modified by someone else since you last fetched it.
Task has dependencies that prevent deletion

get.description: List requests. Accepts the shared `sb` filter — see the `sb` query parameter for syntax. Filterable field keys for this list are documented in the `RequestSbFilterFields` schema.

parameters.name: returnFields[]

post.description: Creates a new request. Delegates to the v1 handler `\Module\Request\Module::postIndex` — ACL (`request/helpdesk` or `request/req-catalog` create rights), admin scoping, and validation are inherited. Unknown fields are silently ignored. **Server-computed fields** (`req_num`/`number`, `creator`/created-by, `updatedby`, close dates, reaction/assign dates) must NOT be sent. Enum ids (`type`, `status`, `priority`, `urgency_id`, `impact_id`, `cat_type_id`, `cat_area_id`, …) are tenant-specific — fetch them via `GET /v3/request/enums`. **Conditional requirements**: many fields become mandatory depending on tenant settings (e.g. `title` is required unless auto-naming is enabled; `type` is required when more than one base type is configured; category, due-date and applicant fields depend on module config). Inspect `GET /v3/request/enums` for the active rules.

id_company.description: Customer / company the request belongs to — FK to `cdesk_companies.id`. Required. Must be visible to the caller (admin-scope filtered).

title.description: Request name (`req_title`). Full-text indexed. Required unless the tenant has auto-naming enabled.

type.description: Base request type (`Druh požiadavky`). FK to the request types enum. Required when more than one base type is configured. Fetch from `/v3/request/enums`.

description.description: Request body / first message (`req_text`, rich HTML allowed). Full-text indexed.

status.description: Request status enum id (`req_status`). Fetch from `/v3/request/enums`. Defaults to the tenant's initial status.

priority.description: Priority enum id (`req_priority`). May be derived server-side from `urgency_id` + `impact_id` when the priority matrix is enabled.

urgency_id.description: Urgency enum id. Combined with `impact_id` to compute priority when the matrix is active.

id_solver.description: Primary solver — FK to `user.id`. Must be visible to the caller.

solver_group_id.description: Solver group id. Used when the tenant resolves solvers by group.

id_rc.description: Real contract id (`cd_real_contracts.id_rc`) to bind the request to.

catalog_id.description: Request-catalog item id. When set, catalog-driven field availability/validation applies.

sla_id.description: SLA id to apply to the request.

calendar_date_start.description: Planned start datetime. ISO-8601 with timezone offset recommended.

applicant.description: Applicant / `for_whom` descriptor (id + source). Resolved into `user_entered_by` / `contact_entered_by` / `entered_by` server-side.

entered_by.description: Free-text applicant name (used when not a system user/contact).

code.description: Request code. Requires the `request/fields/code` write right — without it the value is SILENTLY dropped (200 returned, `code` stays null). Max 30 chars.

for_customer.description: Whether the request is visible to the customer. Default `false`.

close_reason_id.description: Close-reason enum id (required by some tenants on completion).

percent_done_manual.description: Manual progress 0–100. Only relevant when bound to a project contract.

include_fill_hours.description: Whether logged fill hours count toward planned hours.

reaction_missed_id_solver.description: Solver to assign when the reaction deadline is missed.

notify_block.description: Suppress all notifications for this operation when set to 1. Default 0.

notify_customer_block.description: Suppress customer notifications when set to 1. Default 0.

notify_sms_block.description: Suppress SMS notifications when set to 1. Default 0.

customFields.description: Flat custom-field map: keys `cfield_<propertyId>_<basepropertyId>`, values scalar (single-value) or array (multi-value). Discover valid keys via `GET /v3/request/custom-fields`. Unrecognized keys are ignored and reported in the response `warnings` key.

400.description: Validation error (missing required field, invalid enum id, etc.) or unknown custom-field key.

get.summary: List request discussion messages (v3, with returnFields filtering)

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each discussion message (records at `data`). Unknown fields are ignored.

200.description: Discussion messages (newest first), plus `discussionAcl`, `config` and signature metadata.

post.summary: Add a discussion message to a request (v3).
post.description: Adds a discussion post to a request. Delegates to the v1 handler `\Module\Request\Module::__postDiscussion`. The `status` field selects the discussion channel and therefore which text field is used: `1` = customer (external) discussion uses `customer_text` + `customer_to`; `2` = internal note uses `technote_text` + `technote_to`. A message must carry either non-empty text for the chosen channel or at least one attachment. Adding customer messages may be blocked by tenant settings for completed / accepted-completion statuses.

status.description: Discussion channel: `1` = customer (external), `2` = internal note. Determines which text/recipient fields apply.

customer_text.description: Message body for a customer discussion (HTML). Required when `status=1` unless an attachment is provided.

technote_text.description: Message body for an internal note (HTML). Required when `status=2` unless an attachment is provided.

customer_to.description: Recipient descriptor for a customer discussion (auto + manual receivers).

technote_to.description: Recipient descriptor for an internal note.

attachment.description: File hashes to attach to a customer message.

attachment_internal.description: File hashes to attach to an internal note.

customer_signature.description: Append the caller's email signature: `1` = primary, `2` = secondary. Omit for none.

changeStatusToWaitingForCustomer.description: Move the request to 'waiting for customer' after posting.

work_order_id.description: Associate the message with a work order id.

discussion_receivers.description: Explicit list of receiver email addresses.

customNotify.description: When true, use only the manually supplied receivers instead of the auto-resolved set.

notifyBlock.description: Suppress all notifications for this post when set to 1. Default 0.

notifyCustomerBlock.description: Suppress customer notifications when set to 1. Default 0.

notifySmsBlock.description: Suppress SMS notifications when set to 1. Default 0.

requestTimestampCheck.description: Optional optimistic-lock check against the parent request's last-modified timestamp.

400.description: Invalid discussion data, empty message, or posting blocked for the current request status.

get.summary: List custom-field definitions for requests (v3).
get.description: Returns the custom-field catalog for the Request module. Each baseproperty includes a ready-to-use `key` (`cfield_<propertyId>_<basepropertyId>`) — copy it verbatim into the `customFields` object on POST/PUT /v3/request. Workflow: (1) call this endpoint; (2) find the field by `name`; (3) submit `{"customFields": {"<key>": <value>}}` (scalar for single-value; for `select`/`relation` send the option `id`); (4) to read values already stored on a record use `GET /v3/request/{id}?fieldset=custom`. Optional `catalog_id` scopes the catalog to a request-catalog variant.

parameters.name: catalog_id
parameters.description: Optional request-catalog id to scope the custom-field set.

200.description: Custom-field catalog (grouped by property; each baseproperty carries its `cfield_*` key).

get.description: List request catalogs / templates. Accepts the shared `sb` filter — see the `sb` query parameter for syntax. Filterable field keys for this list are documented in the `RequestCatalogSbFilterFields` schema.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each catalog record (the records nested at `data.data` in the response envelope). Unknown fields are ignored. Pagination/meta wrappers are always preserved.

post.description: Creates a new request catalog (template used by `POST /v3/request` via the `catalog_id` field). Delegates to the v1 handler `\Module\RequestCatalog\Module::postIndex` — ACL (`request/catalog` create right), admin scoping, and validation are inherited. Unknown fields are silently ignored. **Server-computed fields** (id, timestamps, created/updated-by) must NOT be sent. The body below documents only the core fields that work for every tenant; many additional fields (change-manager, status-flow, categories, custom fields, work-order relations, tags, visibility groups) are accepted by the v1 handler and may be **required by tenant settings** — fetch the active rules via `GET /v3/request-catalog/enums`.

name.description: Catalog / template name (`Názov šablóny požiadavky`). Required.

code.description: Catalog code. Max 30 characters. Requires the catalog code-field write right — without it the value is SILENTLY dropped (200 returned, `code` stored empty).

desc.description: Default request description applied when a request is created from this template (rich HTML allowed).

type.description: Base request type id (`Druh požiadavky`). Fetch the allowed values from `/v3/request-catalog/enums` → `enums.createOnlyBaseTypes`. Required by the FE only when more than one base type is configured for the tenant; v1 backend tolerates absence when a single base type exists.

use_catalog_item_name.description: When `true`, requests created from this template use the catalog name as their `req_title`. Default `false`.

hide_name.description: Hide the request name field on the request form for requests created from this template. Only honoured when `use_catalog_item_name` is `true`. Default `false`.

hide_description.description: Hide the request description field on the request form for requests created from this template. Default `false`.

400.description: Validation error (missing required field, invalid enum id, conflicting status-flow transitions, etc.).

Each baseproperty includes a ready-to-use `key` (`cfield_<propertyId>_<basepropertyId>`) — copy it verbatim into the `customFields` object on POST/PUT /v3/company. Workflow: (1) call this endpoint; (2) find the field by `name`; (3) submit `{"customFields": {"<key>": <value>}}` (scalar for single-value; for `select`/`relation` send the option `id`); (4) to read values already stored on a record use `GET /v3/company/{id}?fieldset=custom`.

200.description: Custom-field catalog (grouped by property; each baseproperty carries its `cfield_*` key).

get.summary: List users (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: List users. Accepts the shared `sb` filter — see the `sb` query parameter for syntax. Filterable field keys for this list are documented in the `UserSbFilterFields` schema.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each user record (the records inside the response `data` array). Unknown fields are ignored.

parameters.name: fieldset
parameters.description: Preset field group: `base`, `extended` (base+extended), `all` (base+extended+custom), or `custom`. Defaults to `extended` when omitted. Response is always ordered base → extended → custom. Composes with `returnFields[]` (union).

post.description: Creates a new CDESK user account. Password is either set explicitly (via `password` or `encrypted_password`) or auto-generated and emailed to the user when `sendPassword` is true. `id_company` ties the user to a customer/company. `cm_access` is a 2-char flag controlling CMonitor/CDESK access. Caller needs `acl/user/fields/email_settings` write rights to change notification fields on existing users. **`auto_logout` and `ips` are validated on every create — even when CMonitor access is disabled** (`cm_access` position 1 = `N`): `auto_logout` must be a non-zero integer (minutes) and `ips` must be non-empty. Pass `auto_logout`=120 and `ips`=`*.*.*.*` (allow all) if you have no specific values.

user.description: Username. Must be unique within the tenant. NOTE: the v1 handler reads the `user` body key — a `login` key is NOT accepted and fails the username validation.

email.description: Primary email. Required for password reset and notifications.

password.description: Plain-text password (server hashes it). Omit when `sendPassword == true`.

encrypted_password.description: Pre-hashed password (alternative to `password`). Used by SSO/migration tools.

sendPassword.description: Default `false`. When true, server generates a password and emails it to the user.

name.description: Display name. REQUIRED by live validation — `first_name` + `last_name` do NOT substitute for it.

position.description: Job title label. NOT persisted by the v1 handler — the stored record carries `job_title_id` instead.

cm_access.description: 2-char access flag: position 1 = CMonitor (Y/N), position 2 = CDESK (Y/N). Default `'YY'`.

auto_logout.description: CMonitor auto-logout time in minutes. **Required** and must be greater than 0 — validated even when CMonitor access is disabled. Use 120 if you have no specific value.

ips.description: Allowed login IP range — semicolon-separated list of IP patterns. **Required** and must be non-empty — validated even when CMonitor access is disabled. Use `*.*.*.*` to allow all addresses; e.g. `84.45.144.1` or `10.0.0.*;192.168.1.*`.

ad_username.description: Active Directory username for SSO pairing.

help_account.description: `'Y'` to mark as a help-account (non-licensed). Validation gate triggers when set.

email_account.description: `'Y'` for email-only accounts (auto-created from inbound email).

customFields.description: Flat custom-field map: keys `cfield_<propertyId>_<basepropertyId>`, values scalar (single-value) or array (multi-value). Discover valid keys via `GET /v3/user/custom-fields`. Unrecognized keys are ignored and reported in the response `warnings` key.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. username already exists, `name`/`nick` missing, password too weak).

user.description: Username — the v1 handler reads the `user` body key; a `login` key is not accepted.

password.description: New plain-text password. Server rejects if equal to the previous password.

position.description: NOT persisted — the record carries `job_title_id` instead.

auto_logout.description: CMonitor auto-logout minutes. Must be greater than 0 if sent.

ips.description: Allowed login IP range (semicolon-separated patterns; `*.*.*.*` = allow all). Must be non-empty if sent.

customFields.description: Flat custom-field map: keys `cfield_<propertyId>_<basepropertyId>`, values scalar (single-value) or array (multi-value). Discover valid keys via `GET /v3/user/custom-fields`. Unrecognized keys are ignored and reported in the response `warnings` key.

400.description: Validation error.

404.description: User not found in caller's admin scope.

409.description: User has dependencies that prevent deletion (open requests, assignments, etc.)

get.summary: List configuration items (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: List CIs. The CMDB hierarchy filters that the v1 API encodes in the URL path are exposed here as query parameters. Combine `categoryId`/`maingroupId`/`typeId` to scope to a kind of object (e.g. `?typeId=<server type>`). Accepts the shared `sb` filter — see the `sb` query parameter for syntax. Filterable field keys for this list are documented in the `CmdbCiSbFilterFields` schema.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single category id.

parameters.name: maingroupId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single maingroup id or slug. (The v1 handler resolves one maingroup; it does not split comma-separated lists.)

parameters.name: typeId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single CI type id — the practical way to list one kind of object (server, place, vehicle, …).

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Restrict to a single company id.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each CI record (the records nested under the response `data` envelope). Unknown fields are ignored; pagination/meta wrappers are always preserved.

post.description: Creates a CI of the given `type_id`. The CI's category (derived from the type) selects the v1 subclass handler. ACL (`Type::canCreateCI`), validation, the dynamic per-type property schema and all category-conditional required fields are inherited from v1 — it is the authority; its field errors are surfaced verbatim. `company_id` is required for most categories; `branch_ci_id`/`place_ci_id`/`costcenter_ci_id`/`propertyarea_ci_id` are required when the type's config requires them — POST a minimal body and read the 400 to discover them. `type_id` MUST be a JSON integer. Custom fields are sent as the native `properties` payload (discover the schema via `GET /v3/cmdb/types/{id}/properties`). Asset-managed types: see `inventory_number`/`inventory_number_confirm` and the 409 response.

type_id.description: CI type id (FK `cmdb_types.id`). REQUIRED, must be a JSON integer.

name.description: CI name. Required unless the type auto-generates names; then server-computed and a supplied value is ignored.

company_id.description: Owning company. Required for all categories except SERVICES and SUPPLIES.

branch_ci_id.description: Required when the type enables+requires a branch (always for PLACES).

properties.description: Native v1 custom-field payload (one entry per CI property: {id, name, property_group_id, custom, required, multivalue, multivalue_limit, approve, approve_user_id, values:[{id, baseproperties:[{id, name, type_id, value}]}]} — all keys must be present). Discover per-type definitions via GET /v3/cmdb/types/{id}/properties.

inventory_number.description: Explicit inventory number (asset-managed types). A taken value returns 409 with suggested_inventory_number.

inventory_number_confirm.description: Accept the suggested inventory number / proceed despite a conflict (mapped to v1 lockInvNumber).

notify_block.description: Non-zero suppresses notifications for this write.

400.description: Invalid/missing type_id, category not writable via v3, or a v1 validation error.

409.description: Inventory-number conflict — body carries suggested_inventory_number; resend with inventory_number_confirm=true.

get.summary: Get a configuration item detail (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: CI detail, including its resolved type-driven properties.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in the `data` payload.

put.summary: Update a configuration item (v3, partial update)
put.description: Partial update of a CI. The category is taken from the existing CI to select the v1 subclass handler. **Optimistic locking**: include `timestamp_check` from the GET response; a stale token returns a `record updated` conflict. Custom fields use the native `properties` payload (sending it replaces the matched properties). Inventory conflicts surface as 409 (resolve with `inventory_number_confirm=true`). v1 remains the authority for conditional required fields.

schema.description: All fields optional on update. Send only what you want to change.

timestamp_check.description: Optimistic-lock token from the GET response.

400.description: Validation error / category not writable.

409.description: Stale optimistic lock OR an inventory-number conflict (suggested_inventory_number in the body).

delete.description: Soft-deletes a CI (sets `deleted_at`; reversible in the DB). The category is taken from the existing CI to select the v1 subclass handler — the base CI delete is `protected` and runs a category-specific `__delete()` cleanup hook, so it must dispatch through the right subclass (mirrors create/update). Delete ACL (`Acl::canDelete` + the record's `delete` ACL) and the in-use guard are inherited from v1 — e.g. a CI with an active or upcoming borrowing is NOT deleted. No optimistic-lock token is required. Response `data` is `{id}` of the deleted CI.

400.description: CI category is not deletable via /api/v3.

403.description: CI could not be deleted — the delete ACL denied it, or an in-use guard (e.g. an active borrowing) blocked it.

get.summary: Get CI status enums (v3)
get.description: Returns the configuration-item status enums (`Type::getCiStatusesEnums`). By default only active statuses are returned; pass `all` with any non-empty value (e.g. `?all=1`) to include inactive ones — note the v1 handler treats any non-empty value as true, so `?all=0`/`?all=false` ALSO include them; omit the parameter to exclude inactive. CI pick-lists are otherwise type-scoped — categories, maingroups and types come from the `CMDB Catalog v3` endpoints, and per-type property option lists from `GET /v3/cmdb/types/{id}/properties`.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Any non-empty value includes inactive statuses; omit to exclude them.

get.summary: List CMDB categories (v3)
get.description: Returns the full set of CMDB categories visible to the caller (the top of the `Category → Maingroup → Type → CI` hierarchy). This is a small, fixed catalog — it is not paginated and `returnFields[]` is not applied.

get.summary: List CMDB maingroups (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: List maingroups (the second level of the CMDB hierarchy). Filter to a category with `categoryId`.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single category id.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each maingroup record. Unknown fields are ignored; pagination/meta wrappers are always preserved.

post.description: Creates a maingroup (the second level of the `Category → Maingroup → Type → CI` hierarchy). Thin pass-through to the v1 handler; the create ACL (`cmdb/maingroup/record`), validation and slug/translation handling are inherited. Unknown fields are ignored. Response `data` is the full saved maingroup record.

name.description: Maingroup name. Required, non-empty. Full-text indexed.

parent_id.description: Parent maingroup id for nesting — FK to `cmdb_maingroups.id`. Omit/null for a top-level maingroup.

active.description: Whether the maingroup is active. Defaults to true when omitted.

slug.description: URL/identifier slug. Auto-derived from the name when omitted.

thumb.description: Whether an icon thumbnail is used. Defaults to false. When true `icon`/`icon_color` are applied; when false they are cleared.

icon_color.description: Icon color (applied only when `thumb` is true).

translations.description: Per-language overrides for `name`/`description`, keyed by language code. Applied via the v1 translation handler.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. empty name).

get.summary: Get a CMDB maingroup detail (v3, with returnFields filtering)

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in the `data` payload.

put.summary: Update a CMDB maingroup (v3, partial update)
put.description: Partial update — send only the fields you want to change. Thin pass-through to the v1 handler (record `canWrite` ACL). NOTE: maingroup edits are NOT optimistic-locked — there is no `timestamp_check`. Response `data` is the full saved record.

schema.description: All fields optional on update. Send only what you want to change.

thumb.description: When true `icon`/`icon_color` are applied; when false they are cleared.

400.description: Validation error.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a maingroup (sets `deleted_at`; reversible in the DB). Thin pass-through to the v1 handler — the delete ACL and the in-use guard are inherited: a maingroup that still owns CI types is NOT deleted and returns 403 (move or delete its types first). Response `data` carries the v1 bulk-delete counters `{success, failure}`.

400.description: Missing id.

403.description: Maingroup could not be deleted — it still owns CI types, or the delete ACL denied it.

get.summary: List CMDB types (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: List types — the schema-defining level of the CMDB hierarchy. A type is what makes a CI a 'server', 'printer', 'place', etc. Filter with `categoryId` and/or `maingroupId`.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single category id.

parameters.name: maingroupId
parameters.description: Restrict to one or more maingroup ids (comma-separated).

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each type record. Unknown fields are ignored; pagination/meta wrappers are always preserved.

post.description: Creates a type — the schema-defining level of the `Category → Maingroup → Type → CI` hierarchy. Curated contract: the v3 controller reshapes the payload and rejects destructive settings before delegating to the v1 handler (create ACL `cmdb/type/record`). The custom-field set is sent as the flat `properties[]` array (mapped onto the v1 `relations.property` object). NOTE: name-generation and asset-management settings are NOT writable via v3 — see the `409`/rejected-keys note in the description and manage them in the UI (they mass-rewrite every CI of the type). Response `data` is the full saved type record.

thumb.description: Whether an icon thumbnail is used. When true `icon`/`icon_color` are applied; when false they are cleared.

icon.description: Icon identifier (applied only when `thumb` is true).

icon_color.description: Icon color (applied only when `thumb` is true).

properties.description: The type's custom-field set. The FULL list REPLACES the type's current properties — entries present are added/kept (and reordered to array order), entries omitted are removed. Each item references an existing base property by `id`; discover available property ids and the per-type schema via `GET /v3/cmdb/types/{id}/properties`. The v3 controller maps this onto the v1 `relations.property` payload.

id.description: Base property id (the `property_id` to attach to this type).

param_selectbox.description: Use this property as a list/selectbox column.

param_request.description: Show this property on the linked request form.

param_request_detail.description: Show this property on the request detail.

used_ci_statuses.description: The CI status ids enabled for this type (the allowed-status set referenced by `status_flow_transitions`).

status_flow_transitions.description: Status-flow transition restriction, v1-native shape `{value: [ {from, to}, ... ]}`. Validated server-side against `used_ci_statuses`; an invalid transition returns 400.

item_characteristic.description: Property ids flagged as item characteristics for this type.

translations.description: Per-language overrides for `name`/`description`, keyed by language code.

400.description: Validation error, an invalid status-flow transition, OR a rejected name-generation / asset-management key (see description).

get.summary: Get a CMDB type detail (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: Type detail (id, name, description, maingroup, category, slug). For the dynamic property schema a CI of this type carries, call `GET /v3/cmdb/types/{id}/properties`.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in the `data` payload.

put.summary: Update a CMDB type (v3, curated, partial update)
put.description: Partial update — send only the fields you want to change. Curated like `POST /v3/cmdb/types`: `properties[]` is mapped onto the v1 `relations.property` object (sending it REPLACES the type's property set), and the destructive name-generation / asset-management keys are rejected. NOTE: type edits are NOT optimistic-locked — there is no `timestamp_check`. Response `data` is the full saved record.

schema.description: All fields optional on update. Send only what you want to change. Sending `properties[]` replaces the whole property set.

thumb.description: When true `icon`/`icon_color` are applied; when false they are cleared.

properties.description: Replaces the type's custom-field set (see POST). Each item references a base property by `id`; discover ids via `GET /v3/cmdb/types/{id}/properties`.

Thin pass-through to the v1 handler — the delete ACL and the in-use guard are inherited: a type that still has CIs is NOT deleted and returns 403 (delete or re-type its CIs first). Response `data` carries the v1 bulk-delete counters `{success, failure}`.

400.description: Missing id.

403.description: Type could not be deleted — it still has CIs, or the delete ACL denied it.

get.description: Returns the dynamic property definitions a CI of this type carries — the field schema a client needs before reading or (in a later phase) writing CIs of this type. Delegates to the v1 `TypeController::getProperties` handler, which reads the type id from the `type_id` query parameter; this shim bridges the RESTful path id into that contract.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in the `data` payload.

get.summary: List fills (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: List fulfillments. **By default the v1 list returns only the current calendar month** — pass a `start_date`/`end_date` `sb` window (or a wider one) to broaden the range. Accepts the shared `sb` filter — see the `sb` query parameter for syntax. Filterable field keys for this list are documented in the `FillSbFilterFields` schema.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each fill record (the records nested at `data.data` in the response envelope). Unknown fields are ignored. Pagination/meta wrappers are always preserved.

parameters.name: fieldset
parameters.description: Preset field group: `base`, `extended` (base+extended), `all` (base+extended+custom), or `custom`. Defaults to `extended` when omitted. Response is always ordered base → extended → custom. Composes with `returnFields[]` (union).

post.description: Creates a new fulfillment. Delegates to the v1 handler `\Module\Fill\Module::postIndex` — ACL, admin scoping and validation are inherited. Unknown fields are silently ignored. **`assign_id` selects the parent kind and decides which `*_id` is required**: 1=company → `company_id`, 2=contract → `contract_id`, 3=request → `request_id`, 4=work order → `work_order_id`, 5=task → `task_id`, 6=project contract → `project_contract_id`, 7=days-off → none. `solver_id` defaults to the calling user when omitted (non-privileged callers are forced to themselves). `duration` is normally derived from `valid_from`/`valid_to`. **Writes to an already-invoiced fill are blocked** (HTTP 409 unless the caller has the `fulfillment/invoiced` write right), and a `billing_item_id` may be required by tenant billing settings. Enum/FK ids are tenant-specific — fetch them via `GET /v3/fill/enums` and the related module list endpoints.

assign_id.description: Parent entity kind (required). 1=company, 2=contract, 3=request, 4=work order, 5=task, 6=project contract, 7=days-off. Determines which `*_id` below is required.

valid_from.description: Work start datetime (required). Any string `strtotime()` accepts; ISO-8601 with offset recommended (e.g. `2026-05-20T08:00:00+02:00`).

valid_to.description: Work end datetime (required). Must be ≥ `valid_from`. Same format as `valid_from`.

solver_id.description: Worker — FK to `user.id`. Defaults to the calling user; non-privileged callers cannot set another user.

company_id.description: Owning customer — FK to `cdesk_companies.id`. Required when `assign_id`=1; otherwise usually derived from the chosen parent.

contract_id.description: Parent contract — FK to `cd_real_contracts.id_rc`. Required when `assign_id`=2.

request_id.description: Parent request — FK to `cd_req.id_req`. Required when `assign_id`=3.

work_order_id.description: Parent work order — FK to `work_orders.id`. Required when `assign_id`=4.

task_id.description: Parent task — FK to `tasks.id`. Required when `assign_id`=5.

project_contract_id.description: Parent project contract — FK to `project_contracts.id`. Required when `assign_id`=6.

description.description: Work description (rich text). Required unless the tenant enables simplified time entry (`fill.simplifiedEntering`).

private_description.description: Internal note — not shown to the customer.

duration.description: Total work duration in seconds. Normally derived from `valid_from`/`valid_to`; send explicitly only in simplified-entry mode.

place_id.description: Place / location CI — FK to a CMDB place CI. Mutually exclusive with `place_custom`.

place_custom.description: Free-text location, when `place_id` is not used.

place_travel_id.description: Predefined travel route to the location.

billing_item_id.description: Billing catalog item — FK to `cd_billing_item.id`. May be required by tenant billing settings.

billing_kopfis_id.description: Kopfis (external) task id — alternative to `billing_item_id` on Kopfis tenants.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. missing required parent id, `valid_to` < `valid_from`, billing item required).

get.summary: Get fill detail (v3, with returnFields filtering)

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in the `data` payload.

parameters.name: fieldset
parameters.description: Preset field group: `base`, `extended` (base+extended), `all` (base+extended+custom), or `custom`. Defaults to `extended` when omitted. Response is always ordered base → extended → custom. Composes with `returnFields[]` (union).

put.summary: Update a fill (partial update; same handler as POST).
put.description: Partial update — send only the fields you want to change. Underlying CDESK convention is POST-as-update, so PUT delegates to the same `postIndex` handler as `POST /v3/fill`. **Optimistic locking**: the body must include `timestamp_check` equal to the `timestamp_check` value returned by GET (every fieldset includes it; for fills it carries the record's `updated_at`), or the server returns a `recordUpdated` error. A fill that has never been modified has a null `updated_at` — the check is skipped then, so omit the field rather than sending null. **An already-invoiced fill is write-blocked** (HTTP 409 unless the caller holds the `fulfillment/invoiced` write right). All other field semantics, ACL gates and enum sources match `POST /v3/fill` — see that endpoint's description.

schema.description: All fields below are optional on update. Send only what you want to change.

timestamp_check.description: REQUIRED for optimistic locking (skipped only for never-modified fills). Must equal the `timestamp_check` (the record's `updated_at`) you received when last fetching this fill.

assign_id.description: Parent entity kind. Changing it requires sending the new matching `*_id`.

solver_id.description: Worker. Non-privileged callers cannot reassign to another user.

400.description: Validation error.

404.description: Fill not found in caller's admin scope.

409.description: Optimistic-lock failure, or the fill is already invoiced and the caller lacks the `fulfillment/invoiced` write right.

delete.description: Deletes a fulfillment (soft delete). Delegates to the v1 `deleteIndex`. An already-invoiced fill cannot be deleted.

409.description: Fill cannot be deleted (e.g. already invoiced)

get.summary: Get Fill module enums (v3)
get.description: Returns the Fill enum/metadata groups (maingroups, form fields, invoicing statuses/dates, contract & request category types, request status). Use these ids when building create/update payloads and `sb` filters.

get.summary: List contracts (v3, with returnFields filtering)
get.description: List contracts. Accepts the shared `sb` filter — see the `sb` query parameter for syntax. Filterable field keys for this list are documented in the `ContractSbFilterFields` schema. Response keys are remapped: `id` (from `id_rc`), `name` (from `rc_title`); all other keys are raw DB columns.

parameters.name: returnFields[]
parameters.description: Whitelist of top-level fields to keep in each contract record (the records nested at `data.data` in the response envelope). Unknown fields are ignored. Pagination/meta wrappers are always preserved.

parameters.name: fieldset
parameters.description: Preset field group: `base`, `extended` (base+extended), `all` (base+extended+custom), or `custom`. Defaults to `extended` when omitted. Response is always ordered base → extended → custom. Composes with `returnFields[]` (union).

post.description: Creates a new contract. Delegates to the v1 handler `\Module\Contract\Module::postIndex` — ACL (`deal` scope), admin scoping and validation are inherited. Unknown fields are silently ignored. **Write payloads use raw DB column names** (`rc_title`, `rc_code`, `id_company`, `rc_note`, …) — NOT the remapped read keys `name`/`id`. **Server-computed fields** (`rc_num`, `id_rc`, `insert_date`, `update_date`, `close_date`) must NOT be sent; `rc_code` is auto-generated when left blank and code-automatic is enabled. **Lifecycle**: `rc_status`/`rc_phase` are integer *action codes* — when you send an action code without its `*_id`, the server derives the matching `rc_status_id`/`rc_phase_id` from the enum; you may instead send the enum ids directly. Fetch all enum ids/codes via `GET /v3/contract/enums`.

id_company.description: Customer this contract belongs to — FK to `company.id`. Must be visible to the caller (admin-scope filtered).

responsible_person_id.description: Responsible-person user ids (stored via the `contract_responsible_persons` relation, not on the contract row). Required by the standard contract form.

sbFilter.name: sb
sbFilter.description: Search-builder filter for list endpoints. Send a base64-encoded JSON object as the `sb` value (it is base64-decoded then JSON-parsed; spaces are tolerated). Format — structured tree: `{'group': true, 'o': 'AND', 'query': [{'o': 'AND', 'c': 'CONTAINS', 'col': 'title', 'q': 'server'}, {'o': 'AND', 'c': 'THIS_MONTH', 'col': 'close_date'}]}`. Leaf-node fields: `col` (field key), `c` (comparator), `q` (value), `q2` (second value for ranges), `o` (`AND`/`OR` join with the previous node); nodes may nest via `group:true` for parenthesized logic. A leaf with `q` but NO `col` runs the module's default text search (same columns as the list UI quick search) — supported on every list endpoint. Comparators (`c`): `=` `!=` `CONTAINS` `CONTAINSNOT` `ISNULL` `ISNOTNULL` `>` `>=` `<` `<=` `BETWEEN` (q=from, q2=to); booleans `TRUE`/`FALSE`; date presets `TODAY` `YESTERDAY` `THIS_WEEK` `LASTWEEK` `THIS_MONTH` `LASTMONTH` `THIS_YEAR` `PREVIOUS_YEAR` `LAST24H` `NEXT24H`; relative ranges `FOR_THE_LAST`/`FOR_THE_NEXT` (q=amount, q2=unit `m`/`h`/`d`). Each field supports only the comparators named in its description. `BETWEEN` on date fields requires `q`/`q2` STRICTLY in W3C format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM` (e.g. `2026-06-04T00:00:00+02:00`); any other format (incl. plain `YYYY-MM-DD`) makes the clause drop out silently and the result is NOT narrowed. IMPORTANT: an unknown or unsupported `col` key is silently ignored (the clause is dropped without an error and the result set is NOT narrowed) — use only the keys listed in the `<Module>SbFilterFields` schemas (e.g. `RequestSbFilterFields`, `TaskSbFilterFields`) in the Schemas section, named on each list endpoint. Worked example — all requests of solver 42 closed this month: base64-encode `{'group': true, 'o': 'AND', 'query': [{'o': 'AND', 'c': '=', 'col': 'id_solver', 'q': 42}, {'o': 'AND', 'c': '=', 'col': 'status', 'q': CLOSED_ACTION_CODE}, {'o': 'AND', 'c': 'THIS_MONTH', 'col': 'close_date'}]}` (fetch CLOSED_ACTION_CODE from `GET /v3/request/enums`).

includeMetadata.name: include_metadata
includeMetadata.description: When omitted (default), v3 responses return only the resource payload — `data`, plus `savedData` on create/update. Set to `true` (also accepts `1` / `yes`, case-insensitive) to additionally return every auxiliary key the underlying handler produces (e.g. `enums`, `dates_countdown_list`, form-field metadata) and any `debug` messages. Pagination is always returned in headers (`X-TotalRecords` / `X-LastPage` / `X-DraftCount`) regardless of this flag.

apiKeyAuth.description: Two accepted header values. (1) apitoken (recommended): `apitoken <40-hex-token>` — literal `apitoken ` prefix + single space; the `token` field of the `POST /auth/login` response. (2) `Bearer <accessToken>` — the encrypted accessToken from the same response (short-lived JWE). NOTE: the HS256 JWT from `POST /auth/jwttoken` is NOT accepted here — exchange it at `POST /auth/login` for an apitoken.
apiKeyAuth.name: Authorization

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Two ways to obtain the apitoken every endpoint accepts. (1) Credential login: `POST /auth/login` with login + password. (2) OAuth 2.0 machine flow (RECOMMENDED for AI/integration clients — no user password): get a 5-minute HS256 JWT from `POST /auth/jwttoken` using `client_id` (CDESK user id) + `client_secret` (the user's OAuth 2.0 connector signing key), then call `POST /auth/login` with `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` and no body credentials — the response carries the same apitoken. The apitoken expiration is SLIDING: every authenticated call prolongs it by the user's `auto_logout` minutes; it expires only after that much inactivity — then repeat the exchange. Paste `apitoken <token>` into the Scalar 'Authorize' panel and every 'Try it' call includes the header automatically.
